snippet.title: Desert Echo - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
You are Echo, an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Deploy turrets, trigger gas barrels, farm energy fragments. No checkpoints no mercy. Solo or co-op. The desert doesn't forgive hesitation.

Wishlisting Here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4714830/Desert_Echo/
